title: Typing Rush
subtitle: Type the falling words before they reach the danger zone.
sources_help: Select one or more system collections or your own vocabulary folders.
no_user_sources: You have no personal collections yet. Create a folder and save words in My Words.
no_system_sources: No system collections are available yet.
minimum_words: Choose at least {{count}} unique English words to play Typing Rush.
source_unavailable: A collection is no longer available or you do not have access. Please choose your vocabulary again.
request_failed: Unable to start. Check your connection and try again.
sources_failed: Unable to load collections. Please try again.
how_to_play: Finish typing any visible word to submit automatically. Wrong answers only reset your combo; a word reaching the bottom costs a life. Press Esc to pause.
pause_help: The timer and falling words are paused. Continue when you are ready.
input_placeholder: Type the word to submit automatically…
input_help: Finish the word to submit · Esc to pause
typing_hint: Words are selected automatically as you type · Pause 0.8s to finish a shared-prefix short word · Backspace resets · Tab or click to select manually
wrong_answer: No matching falling word. Your combo resets, but you keep your lives.
save_failed: Unable to save your score. Try again before leaving.
disabled: This game is currently disabled. Please return to the games list.
heart_rule: Every {{count}} regular words spawned produces a heart word, including missed words. Type it to gain one life up to the maximum; missing a heart word costs no life.
next_heart: {{count}} more spawned words until a heart
heart_incoming: The next new word will have a heart
meaning_missing: No meaning is available for this word yet.
meaning_hint: Type correctly to see the word meaning.
meaning_typing_subtitle: Read the Vietnamese meaning and type the matching English word.
meaning_typing_hint: Automatic word selection · Pause 0.8s to finish a short word · More hints near the bottom · Backspace resets
rule_hint_percent_value: Gradually reveal up to {{count}}% of the letters near the danger zone
shooter_subtitle: Read the meaning, aim at the matching word, and shoot before time runs out.
shooter_rules: Each round has {{count}} words and {{seconds}} seconds. A correct shot earns 100 points, refreshes the words and resets the timer. A wrong shot costs {{penalty}} seconds. Running out of time ends the game.
shooter_valid_words: Only words with meanings are used. Identical meanings are combined to keep one clear answer per round.
shooter_minimum_words: Select sources with at least {{count}} words with distinct meanings.
shooter_play_hint: Click a word to shoot · Correct: new round and timer reset · Wrong: time penalty · Esc pauses
